tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: The brand. App tile, one hero field per page, the product card stage, ad backgrounds. Text on it is ink-fixed only (6.6:1); white text on it fails (2.9:1).

tokens.name: orange-text
tokens.usage: Orange for text and links on surface and surface-2: 5.2:1 and 4.7:1 light, 8.0:1 and 7.5:1 dark.

tokens.name: orange-tint
tokens.usage: Soft orange ground for highlights and the cover. Text on it is text (16:1 light, 12.7:1 dark), never orange-text.

tokens.name: ink-fixed
tokens.usage: The mark's ink: the buy button in the logo, text and buttons on orange. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: white-fixed
tokens.usage: The mark's white: the photo window and the title line. Text on ink-fixed (18.6:1).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Alternate sections and panels: honesty, pricing, screenshot frames.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on surface and surface-2: 18.6:1 and 16.8:1 light, 16.5:1 and 15.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Leads, answers, secondary copy on surface and surface-2: 7.3:1 and 6.6:1 light, 10.4:1 and 9.6:1 dark.

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Captions, eyebrows, footnotes on surface and surface-2: 5.4:1 and 4.8:1 light, 6.5:1 and 6.0:1 dark.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and card borders. Decorative: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and secondary buttons: 3.6:1 on surface light, 4.0:1 dark.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill: ink in light, orange in dark. One primary action per view.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label on action and action-hover: 18.6:1 and 12.8:1 light, 6.6:1 and 7.6:1 dark.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px gap in surface, then a solid 2px ring. 18.6:1 on surface and 6.6:1 on orange light, 8.0:1 on surface dark.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Check marks in lists of what stays yours: 5.3:1 light, 8.5:1 dark. Always next to words.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Form errors only, always with words: 5.9:1 light, 7.5:1 dark. Never for urgency.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: A product page for every product you test.
styles.usage: The one hero headline of a landing page or feature image. 44px on phones.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Section openers and the final call to action. 36px on phones.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.sample: Pick a product from your catalog

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Step titles, FAQ questions, card titles.

styles.name: text-lead
styles.sample: Pick a product from your catalog. Ecomwerce writes its page on your store.
styles.usage: The lead under a hero headline, in text-2.

styles.name: text-body
styles.sample: See the page on your store first. It goes live only when you press Go live.
styles.usage: Paragraphs, at most 65 characters a line.

styles.name: text-small
styles.sample: Free to install. Your first 2 product pages are free, then $3 per product page.
styles.usage: Captions, footnotes, the price sentence under a button.

styles.name: data-label
styles.usage: Eyebrows above headings, set in uppercase, in text-3.

styles.name: data-figure
styles.usage: Prices, times and counts. Mono marks a figure as measured.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside buttons and between tight inline items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card internals: window to title, title to price.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Minimum page gutter on phones; gap between buttons.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Grid gutter; panel padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Stage padding around a product card.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between hero text and the stage.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Inputs, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: The product photo window, cards, screenshots.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Large panels and the orange stage.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every button: the shape of the mark's buy button.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: The app tile when we show it ourselves (landing, docs). The App Store rounds the uploaded square itself.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Only for a product card or photo lifted off the orange stage.
